_comment: The staff's circles laid out as a symbol (the owner, 2026-11-27; docs/gameplay/22 §5.1; src/core/game/systems/circle_symbols.h).
The circles are always numbered 1, 2, 3 ... in their order. A symbol is a shape: a ring, a row, a star, or a letter (A5 = an A in 5
circles, traced in the order it is written).
symbols: each its circles' places in tap order, [x, y] each 0..1 across and down the play's area (the middle of the screen, about 560 x 340);
times: when each lights up as they are shown (ms, the first 0; none: battle.json plays circleCountMs apart);
rotate: may start at any of its points (a ring); reverse: may run backwards; mirror: may flip left to right (each half the time);
curve: the battle editor's (its Symbols tab): the curve the circles came from, kept for the next edit.
weapons: rows by level (a row sets only what it has; a level takes the rows up to it): chance = % of plays that show a symbol (else the
circles go anywhere, apart); symbols = the ones it may show, with weights.
A play of N circles picks among the symbols with exactly N points (none: those with more, their first N). The staff has 6 circles at

ring5._comment: five round a ring, clockwise (reverse: anticlockwise), from any of them

line5._comment: a row left to right (reverse: right to left)

star5._comment: a pentagram, corner to corner as it is drawn

z6._comment: the letter Z: top row, the slant, the bottom

n6._comment: the letter N: up, the slant down, up

A5._comment: the letter A: up the left leg, down the right (5 circles)

A6._comment: the letter A: up the left leg, down the right (6 circles)

B5._comment: the letter B: up its back, round the top bump to the middle, round the bottom bump (5 circles)

B6._comment: the letter B: up its back, round the top bump to the middle, round the bottom bump (6 circles)

C5._comment: the letter C: from its top round the left to its bottom (5 circles)

C6._comment: the letter C: from its top round the left to its bottom (6 circles)

D5._comment: the letter D: down its back, then its curve from the bottom up (5 circles)

D6._comment: the letter D: down its back, then its curve from the bottom up (6 circles)

E6._comment: the letter E: the top bar right to left, down to the middle bar, then the bottom bar (6 circles)

M5._comment: the letter M: up, down to the middle, up, down (5 circles)

S6._comment: the letter S: from its top right, round and down to its bottom left (6 circles)

U5._comment: the letter U: down the left, round, up the right (5 circles)

U6._comment: the letter U: down the left, round, up the right (6 circles)

V5._comment: the letter V: down to the point, up the right (5 circles)
